text:
jules: Quick follow-up on the auth RFC. Proposal: switch to a compact claims-first token for services (svc_id, tenant, scope, caps), keep heavy delegation proofs server-side and reference them by assertion_id. Keeps token small and common-case fast.
remy: Sounds promising. How do we avoid runtime fetching on the hot path?
sophia: Cache resolved assertion->policy in an in-process LRU with short TTL and ship a tiny on-disk snapshot so restarts aren't cold. Also add a bloom filter to quickly rule out missing assertions.
kai: Bloom + LRU ok, but tail latency matters. We should instrument p50/p95/p99 for auth checks under synthetic load (5-20% delegation).
maria: Migration worry: we have thousands of legacy keys named with org:project prefixes. We need a nonbreaking path.
jules: Plan: support v1 and v2 simultaneously. Add /token/exchange to mint v2 from v1 after PoP. Runtime accepts both; SDKs surface a non-fatal migration warning when v1 seen.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary flag claims-first-exchange scheduled in us-east-1, 10% rollout.
remy: Auditability: shim/exchange mappings must be logged but not leak secrets. Proposal: store hash(original_key) + resolved claims + timestamp, sampled at 1% for full detail.
sophia: Agreed. No raw keys in logs. Also require retention limits (30d) and RBAC on audit store.
kai: Edge-case: offline clients that can't call auth to fetch proofs. Options: optional proof_blob in token (signed JWS), or allow longer-lived v2 tokens for approved offline services. Both require strict controls.
maria: TTLs: delegation assertions 15m, svc tokens default 12h, operator tokens 1h and enforced rotation. Revocation API required.
devex: SDK UX: emit x-auth-migration header and a non-blocking console banner; add auth migrate-key command to help customers.
jules: Security: assertion_id and proof_blob keys rotate in KMS/HSM; /token/exchange requires mTLS and rate limits.
remy: If prototype shows too many remote fetches, gateway can batch assertion lookups per request batch as fallback. But only if caching can't bring miss rate low.
sophia: Action items: sophia+kai build LRU+bloom prototype + perf harness (due Wed). remy+maria draft migration playbook + audit retention policy (due Fri). devex add SDK warning + CLI command (PR in two weeks). I'll write claim schema and sample token shapes.
jules: Short sample v2 token (JSON): ```{ "iss":"redwood-auth", "sub":"svc:ingest-processor", "claims_v":"2", "tenant":"t-12345", "scope":"project", "caps":["write:ingest","read:config"], "assertion_id":"a-9f3b", "exp":1754339999 }```
kai: Good. Let's measure before locking anything. If p99 penalty > 5ms, iterate on coalescing or local snapshot TTL.
maria: Schedule architecture review next Tue to sign off on rollout plan. :thumbsup:
